The front bumper cover is cracked and displaced on the driver's side, with the grille support and both headlamp brackets bent
inward. The radiator support shows a clean fold consistent with a frontal strike at low speed, and the damage pattern lines up with
the reported impact. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account. The repair plan calls for
replacing the bumper cover and brackets, straightening the support, and refinishing the front end. Labor hours appear slightly
high for this scope, so I have asked the shop to review the sequence and confirm the time allowances. The invoices reviewed
show no repeated charges for the same operations.
